Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { WasmCrawlConfig, batchScrape, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = WasmCrawlConfig.default();
  engineConfig.ssrf.denyPrivate = false;
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const urls = ["https://example.com/good1", "https://example.com/bad", "https://example.com/good2"];
  const result = await batchScrape(engine, urls);
  console.log(result.completedCount);
  console.log(result.failedCount);
  console.log(result.totalCount);
}

void main();
```
